$Comment: Weakpoint node. Renders the ore item's own model and texture but is a real damageable entity, which a dropped item entity cannot be because those are intangible. The model and textures are bundled copies under Items/ because ModelAsset only accepts Characters/, NPC/, Items/ and VFX/ as roots, and the vanilla ore art lives under Resources/. HitBox is authored at unit scale; the variant's WeakpointScale grows it.
